title.narrative: COSAMI New Guarantee for Loans - COSAMI New Guarantee for Loans subsidy

description.narrative: Sida assesses that the guarantee is an effective instrument to increase access to finance for micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Guatemala, particularly in the country’s poorer regions where financial exclusion is widespread. The intervention helps reduce structural barriers such as lack of collateral and high perceived credit risk, which limit MSMEs’ access to loans despite viable business models and repayment capacity. The guarantee aims to reduce credit risk for COSAMI, Guatemala’s largest savings and credit cooperative, thereby enabling increased lending to MSMEs, including women-owned and women-led businesses. Through this, the intervention is expected to contribute to employment, income generation, and economic empowerment. The intervention is aligned with Sweden’s strategy for development cooperation with Guatemala (2021–2025, extended to June 2026), in particular the objectives of: inclusive economic development increased opportunities for productive employment strengthened economic empowerment of women The guarantee is expected to mobilize GTQ 100 million (equivalent to SEK 121,800,000 at an exchange rate of 1.218 as of 13 March 2026) in private capital for productive investments in the MSME sector

Sida bedömer att garantin är ett effektivt instrument för att öka tillgången till finansiering för mikro-, små- och medelstora företag (MSME) i Guatemala, särskilt i landets fattigare regioner där den finansiella exkludering är omfattande. Insatsen bidrar till att minska strukturella hinder, såsom brist på säkerheter och hög upplevd kreditrisk, vilka begränsar MSME:s tillgång till lån trots fungerande affärsmodeller och betalförmåga. Garantin syftar till att minska kreditrisken för COSAMI, Guatemalas största spar-och kreditkooperativ och därmed möjliggöra ökad utlåning till MSME, inklusive företag som ägs och sköts av kvinnor. Genom detta förväntas insatsen bidra till sysselsättning, inkomster och ekonomisk egenmakt. Insatsen är i linje med Sveriges strategi för utvecklingssamarbetet med Guatemala (2021–2025, förlängd till juni 2026), särskilt målen om: inkluderande ekonomisk utveckling ökade möjligheter till produktiv sysselsättning och stärkt ekonomisk egenmakt för kvinnor Garantin förväntas mobilisera 100 miljoner GTQ (motsvarande i SEK 121 800 000, vid växelkurs om 1,218 per den 2026-03-13 ) i privat kapital till produktiva investeringar i MSME-sektorn.

The mobilized capital will be used to support entrepreneurs and their businesses in the agricultural, livestock, trade, and service sectors, as such contributing to increasing incomes and overall financial inclusion in Guatemala.
It is a way to (i) mobilize capital from financial institutions to boost the economic and social development of vulnerable populations lacking access capital; (ii) to promote financial inclusion, with the support of the EU delegation for the Inclusive Finance Initiative that promotes digitalization and technological innovation in the financial sector and the development of new products such as women MSME lending, and (iii) promote the development and strengthening of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) that contribute to economic development and the creation of jobs and self-employment.
